glyph_probe_resolution.finding: All 18 flagged math-extension glyph locations visibly render their parenthesis/delimiter. No missing visible glyph was found at these locations. PyMuPDF extracts U+0000 there; independent Poppler text extraction contains no NUL or replacement character.
glyph_probe_resolution.classification: Documented PDF-to-Unicode extraction limitation; not a detected visible layout defect.

findings: No visible clipping, overlap, anomalous empty page or broken page layout was found across all 19 contact sheets covering 206 pages.
All three title pages and the selected central theorem/proof pages were legible at 150 dpi, with intact formula alignment, headers, folios and margins.
The main article's Proposition 4.6 continues from page 11 to page 12; its qubit formula and proof are intact. This is an ordinary page continuation.
The supplement page 103 table and page 112 plot were enlarged and inspected. Table entries, equation labels, axis labels, staggered transition labels and caption are contained and readable.
The 18 math-extension NUL extraction locations were individually inspected through enlarged crops. Their delimiters are visible; this remains a text extraction limitation.

limitations: Every page was visually inspected at contact-sheet scale; 18 selected complete pages and all 18 flagged glyph crops were inspected enlarged. This is not full-size line-by-line scrutiny of every page.
All-page Poppler renders and raw RGB hashes bind visible content at the recorded 80 dpi and renderer settings; they do not establish mathematical validity.
Text-bounds probes find page-boundary excursions, not every possible typographic overlap or accessibility issue.
The math extension font has 18 PyMuPDF U+0000 extraction anomalies despite its visible delimiters rendering correctly. No general claim of perfect PDF-to-Unicode extraction is made.
This is AI layout scrutiny, not human mathematical referee assessment, formal proof verification, priority certification or an editorial decision.
